Question B-006-003-006.

Why the correct answer is right: Type N connectors are designed for good radio-frequency (RF) performance and better weather resistance than many older general-purpose RF connectors. They are common where outdoor VHF or UHF feedlines need robust connections.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "UHF": UHF-style PL-259/SO-239 connections are common, but they normally need careful external weatherproofing outdoors.
- sourceIndex 2: "BNC": BNC is convenient for quick connections on instruments and portable gear, but moisture resistance is not its main design identity here.
- sourceIndex 3: "SMA": SMA is compact and threaded, yet its small size does not make it the standard moisture-resistant connector named in this question.
